name: filamental
description: Connect Claude to your Filamental knowledge graph. Search nodes, follow connections, and read or write vault content directly from Claude Desktop -- no copy-paste required.
long_description:
Filamental is a 3D knowledge graph desktop app. This extension gives Claude live read/write access to your vault -- the same data the app uses -- so you can ask questions, find connections, and build out your graph entirely from conversation.

No vault path needed. The extension reads whichever world you have open in Filamental and switches automatically when you change worlds.

**What Claude can do:**
- Search across all node names, notes, and properties
- Retrieve full node records and follow connections
- Traverse subgraphs to understand clusters of related content
- Create, update, and delete nodes
- Add and remove edges between nodes

Changes made through Claude appear immediately the next time you open the vault in Filamental.

**Requires:** Filamental desktop app installed and at least one vault opened.

tools.name: get_vault_info
tools.description: Return summary counts (nodes, edges) and the entity and connector type names configured for this vault.

tools.name: list_node_types
tools.description: Return the full entity type configuration for this vault.

tools.name: list_connector_types
tools.description: Return the full connector type configuration for this vault.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Full-text search across node names, note bodies and property values. Returns matching nodes with a contextual snippet.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Retrieve the full node record for a given entity UUID.

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Get all edges connected to a node, with source and target names resolved.

tools.name: get_subgraph
tools.description: BFS traversal from a root node collecting all reachable nodes and edges up to a given hop depth (max 3).

tools.name: create_node
tools.description: Create a new node -- writes a markdown file and updates the SQLite index.

tools.name: update_node
tools.description: Update an existing node; omitted fields are unchanged.

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Delete a node and remove it from the index and all relationships.

tools.name: create_edge
tools.description: Add a relationship between two nodes.

tools.name: delete_edge
tools.description: Remove a relationship between two nodes.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Assemble one readable markdown document for a node and its neighbourhood, with headings tracking hop distance and each node labelled by the connector it was reached through.

tools.name: extract_section
tools.description: Lift a heading's section out into its own node, leaving the heading and a wikilink behind, and connect the two.

tools.name: inline_section
tools.description: Fold a node's content back into the document that links to it, the inverse of extract_section.

tools.name: read_skill_guide
tools.description: Read the full Filamental skill guide: how to design a space, choose entity and connector types, and structure a graph well.

tools.name: read_format_reference
tools.description: Read the exact on-disk file format: the YAML frontmatter fields of a node and how relationships are stored.
